name: productbyte
description: Create social campaigns and review e-commerce performance with ProductByte.

interface.longDescription: For webshop owners and e-commerce marketers: create social posts, manage campaigns and review performance from your ProductByte workspace. Find products, compose images and carousels, review drafts, and schedule or publish posts to connected channels. Explore sales and social insights, and inspect product sources and destinations. Requires a ProductByte account and access to a workspace. Available actions depend on your connection permissions and connected channels. Publishing posts requires your authorization.
defaultPrompt: Check last week and create 3 posts for this week

positive.description: A marketer picks products under €50 to put in a promotion.
positive.prompt: Find our products under €50 for a promotion
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says how many products cost less than €50 and shows them in a product card where you can select the ones to promote. Nothing in the shop or workspace changes.

positive.description: A marketer plans a Black Friday campaign with images of their products.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT proposes which products to feature and how the images look, following the brand playbook, and asks before creating anything. Once you agree, it creates a Black Friday campaign and starts the images. As no social channel is connected, it says posts need one and offers to connect it.

positive.description: A marketer wants a new styled photo of one of their products.
positive.prompt: Make a product photoshoot of one of our products
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT suggests products from the catalogue and asks which one to use, then starts one photo in the style of the brand playbook. It says the photo is being made and, when you ask, whether it is done. It creates no posts or campaign.

positive.description: A marketer shows off their newest products in one carousel.
positive.prompt: Make a carousel of our new arrivals
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT picks the most recently added products, names them, and starts one carousel in the style of the brand playbook. It says the carousel is being made and creates no posts or campaign.

positive.description: A marketer groups every product on sale into one collection.
positive.prompt: Make a product collection for all products in sale
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT says how many products are on sale and creates a collection of them. Products join or leave the collection on their own as their sale starts or ends.

negative.description: A fun image with no product or brand. ChatGPT makes it with its own image generation.
negative.prompt: Make an image of a cat wearing sunglasses

negative.description: Public sales of another brand, not your workspace. ChatGPT answers from the web.
negative.prompt: What were Nike's best-selling sneakers last year?

negative.description: A personal post with nothing to sell. ChatGPT writes the caption itself.
negative.prompt: Write a funny Instagram caption for a photo of my dog

publication.release_notes: Create campaigns, product images and social posts, check performance and manage product feeds.
